author: install_repairs
result: No concrete safety or accuracy finding
source_review: Reads filesystem metadata, hashes its own source, task XML and classified process command lines; does not publish task actions or raw command lines.
Inspects fixed controls and immediate CoChem roots; observed reparse ancestors are refused.
Distinguishes access denial, not found and other errors; does not infer quiescence or zero spend.
Does not open database or credential contents, write files, alter tasks/processes, call providers or migrate budget authority.
bound_qualification: 32-root and 256-process caps bound accepted downstream/report scope after collection, not a universal wall-clock bound. CIM has a 15-second operation timeout; filesystem and COM calls do not.
